description: Updates an existing label in a GitLab project by modifying its name, color, description, priority, or archived status. At least one of new_name or color must be provided to perform the update. Use this action when you need to rename a label, change its appearance, update its description, adjust its priority, or archive/unarchive it.

archived.description: Set to true to mark the label as archived, false to unarchive. Defaults to false.
archived.title: Archived

color.description: The new color for the label in 6-digit hex notation with leading '#' (e.g., #FFAABB) or CSS color name. Required if new_name is not provided.
color.title: Color

description.description: The new description for the label.
examples: Critical bugs that need immediate attention
description.title: Description

id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
id.title: Id

label_id.description: The ID or title of the label to update.
label_id.title: Label Id

new_name.description: The new name for the label. Required if color is not provided.
new_name.title: New Name

priority.description: The new priority for the label. Must be greater than or equal to 0, or set to null to remove priority.
priority.title: Priority

name: update_label

archived.description: Indicates if the label is archived.
archived.title: Archived

closed_issues_count.description: The count of closed issues with this label.
closed_issues_count.title: Closed Issues Count

color.description: The color of the label in hex format (e.g., #FF0000).
color.title: Color

description_html.description: The HTML-rendered description of the label.
description_html.title: Description Html

id.description: The unique identifier of the label.
id.title: Id

is_project_label.description: Indicates if the label belongs to a project (true) or a group (false).
is_project_label.title: Is Project Label

open_issues_count.description: The count of open issues with this label.
open_issues_count.title: Open Issues Count

open_merge_requests_count.description: The count of open merge requests with this label.
open_merge_requests_count.title: Open Merge Requests Count

priority.description: The priority of the label, or null if not set.
priority.title: Priority

subscribed.description: Whether the user is subscribed to notifications for this label.
subscribed.title: Subscribed

text_color.description: The text color for the label in hex format.
text_color.title: Text Color
